reviews.title: Nearly Everything Is Locked
reviews.text:
I’ve never felt compelled to leave an app review before, but this change deserves one.

I’ve been an NBC News viewer for over 20 years, and I’ve relied on this app to stay informed. Unfortunately, over the past six months, the app has shifted so heavily toward a subscription model that it feels like more than 95% of the stories on the home page are now locked behind a paywall.

I understand that news organizations need to generate revenue, but when almost everything on the front page requires a subscription, the app no longer provides much value to longtime users. Instead of encouraging me to subscribe, it’s encouraged me to look elsewhere for my news.

After more than two decades with NBC News, you’ve completely lost me. I can’t recommend this app to others when there are plenty of news sources that still provide meaningful access without putting nearly every headline behind a paywall.

As of late, almost all the stories on NBC News are “for subscribers only”. As someone on a fixed income, I cannot afford to be a subscriber. It is really sad. Also, I do manage to pay for a subscription to Peacock and sort of feel robbed  that my Peacock subscription doesn’t cover the news app. :(

reviews.title: Still a free app… only pay for the reporting inside it!
reviews.text:
I don’t mind paywalls. I really don’t. Video and podcasts behind a paywall? Fine, I don’t need them. Deeper analysis behind a paywall? I don’t like it, but I get it.

But these last couple of weeks…?
— Breaking news paywalled
— Five of the first seven headlines in the app all paywalled
— Entire sections of coverage paywalled

At this point, you’re not providing actual “news” to the free user — just headlines in hopes of selling a subscription. For that reason, as much as I’ve preferred NBC News for a while, I’m out.

Also provide viewers with more options about what to watch.
